intro: The Manchester component canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/HrFjMqHqr8W3tqTNsMt7wb. Thirteen components, three designs each, shown at phone, tablet and desktop. Pick A, B or C for each one on the canvas (or "None — redesign" with a note), then press "Send picks to Claude" there.

questions.context: Every design is new to Manchester or a London design you did not pick, refreshed on one named axis, so nothing repeats London's page. Recommended: (a). Trade-off: a "redesign" pick costs one more design round for that component (about 1.5 hours) before the build.
